description: Generates a bridge deck (beam grillage or plate mesh) with the Skew Grillage Geometry Generator plugin's own engine: skew, unequal girders, plan curvature, multi-span, crossfall and vertical profile, automatic transverse section sizing and structure groups (GIRDERS, CROSS-BEAMS, END-BEAMS for the support-line members, SPAN-n, or DECK for plates). Without apply it only previews (counts, metrics, groups, planHash). With apply: true it writes to CIVIL NX exactly as the plugin does: it refuses a model that already holds geometry unless replaceExisting is set, creates default material/sections/thickness where the ids are missing, and records the run for skew_grillage_undo.

allowDefaultProperties.description: Create a default C30-like material and rectangular sections/thickness when the ids are not in the model.

apply.description: Write to CIVIL NX. Only after the user approved the preview.

autoTransverseSections.description: One transverse section per measured tributary width (beam decks).

confirmPlanHash.description: planHash from the approved preview; the write is refused if the plan differs.

geometry.description: Deck inputs, named as in the plugin. Anything omitted takes the plugin form's default. Lengths in metres, angles in degrees.

elementType.description: beam = grillage of girders and cross beams; plate = plate-mesh deck.

endSkewAngle.description: Skew of the end support if different (a trapezium deck).

girderSpacings.description: Unequal girder spacings, edge to edge; sets the count and the width.

levelsEnabled.description: Turn on crossfall and vertical profile.

orientation.description: Cross beams parallel to the supports, or square to the girders.

skewAngle.description: Skew of the start support from square, degrees (±60).

supports.description: Multi-span: one row per support line (spans + 1): skew, joint gap a, bearing offset b.

transverseSpacing.description: Cross-beam (or plate) spacing along the span.

replaceExisting.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete all nodes, elements, sections, thicknesses, materials and structure groups first. Only with the user's explicit agreement.

name: skew_grillage
title: Skew Grillage Geometry Generator
